name: Nekocon
blurb: Finland's Japanese pop-culture convention in Kuopio, bringing together anime, manga, cosplay and gaming fans.
notes: Most recent edition (Nekocon's 20th anniversary) ran 18-19 July 2026 at Kuopio Musiikkikeskus / taidelukio Lumit; that date is already past. The homepage has no mention of a 2027 date yet as of 2026-10-05, so editions is empty. Cover uses the 2026 key art since no 2027 art exists; organizer is 'Nekocon ry' per the site's own 'NEKOCON RY' nav label.
